name: hunters-concept-20261015b
_note: Jacob 15 Oct on the first concepts: "they are copyrights right there make them fit but fat like sentinal this is no go". Own reptile race, no dragon heads, wings or tail, heavy strongman build; three head readings, one colourway. Local Krea 2 Turbo, same graph as hunters-concept-20261015.

options.label: crocodile head
options.prompt: Full body character concept art of a crocodile headed warrior: a broad, flat crocodile like snout with a heavy jaw and armoured scutes along the skull. He is one of the Sovereign's hunters, their standard bearer, in a dark fantasy game: an original reptilian race, not a dragon. Fit but fat: a heavy, powerful strongman build, broad shoulders, a thick neck, a barrel chest and a big hard belly, thick strong arms and legs. Striking and good looking in a brutal way, proud, with a calm cold stare. Goth look: black scales with a silver sheen, two small horns, and two thin flaps of skin hanging down on either side of his chin like a goatee. He wears heavy, fitted black gothic body armour with silver edges over his scales, and a black cape with a blood red lining. One hand holds a tall war banner on a pole planted upright beside him, a blood red banner with a black sigil hanging above his head; on his other arm is a heavy black shield with a silver rim. He stands in a three quarter view facing left, the whole body from horns to feet and the whole banner in frame. No wings and no tail. Plain flat grey background. Painted fantasy concept art, clean readable silhouette, crisp detail, no text.
